name: Losslessly packed BF16 single-token lm_head
hypothesis: An exact auxiliary encoding of the BF16 output weight reduces M=1 memory traffic enough to improve complete requests while preserving greedy output tokens.
expected_global_effect: Reduce batch-one decode latency without changing the GPTQ backbone, attention, scheduler, sampling policy, vocabulary, or checkpoint values.

preserved_dependencies: the original BF16 weight remains loaded and is the fallback source
the auxiliary representation reconstructs every original BF16 weight bit
the GPTQ backbone, attention, scheduler, vocabulary and greedy sampling stay unchanged
ineligible dtypes, layouts and request shapes use the stock method
changed_boundaries: eligible BF16 lm_head weights receive a non-persistent auxiliary layout after loading
eligible M=1 projections execute a source-hash-bound Triton kernel
prohibited_rewrites: no quantization or approximation of the output head
no vocabulary shortlist, speculative decoding, skipped work or changed sampling
dependency_contract.numerical_ordering: The weight representation is bit-exact, while the legal FP32 accumulation tree can differ; promotion therefore requires exact greedy token identity on all frozen anchor and edge cases.

evidence.claim: The replay worker validates and loads the exact vLLM PR source files before engine initialization.
